summary.intent: Finalize phase 43 (FUSE write durability) for the CipherBox project: verify all critical review findings were fixed in code, run a simplify pass, open a PR via /gsd:ship, and address all automated and human review comments through to merge-readiness.
summary.outcome: PR #487 was opened for feat/fuse-write-durability. All 8 CR criticals were verified fixed in code (CR-03 TEE-key fallback and CR-04 mutation-before-journal both fully resolved). A /simplify pass ran with 3 cleanups applied and 6 deferred items captured as todos. codecov coverage was improved via extraction of a pure bridge_status function (8 new tests) and wiring the Rust crate llvm-cov output to a new codecov 'rust' flag. All CodeRabbit inline threads and body comments were addressed and pushed.

repo: After `gh pr create`, `github-actions[bot]` immediately pushes a `chore(release)` commit via release-please to the PR branch, causing the next local push to be rejected; always `git fetch` + `git rebase origin/<branch>` before pushing post-PR-creation.
All 111 CI action references use version tags, not SHA pins — pinning a single action would make it the only SHA-pinned reference in the repo; repo-wide pinning is a separate initiative.
The `Entire` CLI pre-push hook runs a checkpoint sync on every push, adding significant latency (30–90s) to every push operation.

crates/fuse and crates/sdk coverage was invisible to codecov despite the workspace llvm-cov job capturing it — the `desktop` flag's path filter (`apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**`) silently discarded all crate lines; adding a second upload with a `crates/**` path fixed it without any new CI job.
The `patch` coverage status and `desktop` codecov flag are both `informational: true` — they are advisory and never block merge.
The winfsp feature gate (Windows-only) means all winfsp Rust code is uncompilable on macOS; CI is the sole compile check for those paths.
The branch contained 22 redundant phase-42 commits (branch predates squash PR #485) but the net diff vs origin/main was phase-43-only; squash-merge is required to avoid bundling historical noise.
The `.planning/` directory is excluded from the markdownlint pre-commit hook — planning docs commit without lint checks.
GSD verification gate (`human_needed`) blocks `/gsd:ship` even when UAT is complete but not yet recorded in VERIFICATION.md; the fix is to update the doc before shipping, not to bypass the gate.
1Password SSH signing can wedge after a failure with 'failed to fill whole buffer / fatal: failed to write commit object'; quitting and relaunching 1Password recovers it — never use --no-gpg-sign.

code.finding: CR-03 residual: the error fallback for wrap_key used encrypted_ipns_for_tee (TEE-wrapped key) instead of String::new(); replay cannot unwrap with user key, silently corrupting journal entries.
CR-03 winfsp: same TEE fallback issue in the Windows cleanup path; also called cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key instead of cipherbox_crypto::ecies::wrap_key inconsistently (cosmetic, likely a re-export).
Parent IPNS key wrap failure was swallowed via .ok() producing an empty key, silently degrading journal entries without any log warning.
TrayStatus::WriteParked was missing from is_connected(), which only gates the tray Logout menu item — so an authenticated user with parked uploads could not log out.

resolve_folder_key used 'depth'/'MAX_RESOLVE_DEPTH' but the variable counts nodes visited, not tree depth; the error message at line 1089 and doc comment at 1024 were both missed in the initial rename pass.
journal_no_plaintext test contained a no-op probe: plaintext_probe was never inserted into the journal so the assertion never exercised anything; replaced with a meaningful raw-key-bytes assertion.

Four pure functions (sanitize_error, regex_replace_paths, regex_replace_tokens, is_network_error) have zero unit tests and 0% codecov coverage despite being trivially testable — security-relevant as log-redaction helpers.

spawn_sync_daemon idempotency guard had a TOCTOU race: separate read-check and write-store allowed two concurrent callers to both pass the check and spawn duplicate daemon loops, doubling WriteParked notifications and undermining the D-10 anti-spam work.

workflow: CodeRabbit body comments (out-of-diff-range, nitpicks) are not resolvable via the GraphQL reviewThreads API — they must be addressed by fixing + pushing, then posting a disposition summary comment on the PR.

CR-04 'inode rollback on prepare failure' was most cleanly implemented by deferring all in-memory mutations until after journal.put() commits — the journal becomes the commit point, eliminating the need for any rollback API.

A 4-agent /simplify review (reuse/simplification/efficiency/altitude) running in parallel produces strongly converging findings; all four agents independently flagged the fuser↔winfsp write-path duplication as the highest-value item.
When the existing llvm-cov workspace job already covers all crates, adding a new codecov flag only requires a second upload step with a different path filter — no new cargo invocation needed.

Exit code 0 from a background Bash task can be misleading when the command is piped through `tail` — the git commit itself failed (signing error) but the pipeline returned 0; always verify with `git log` after a background commit.
The gsd_run verification status command reliably exposes the next_action and next_command fields — use these rather than manually parsing VERIFICATION.md to understand what the gate wants.

friction: 1Password SSH signing wedged twice with 'error: 1Password: failed to fill whole buffer / fatal: failed to write commit object', requiring a full 1Password restart between attempts and wasting ~10 minutes.
Network timeout during push (Failed to connect to github.com port 443 after 75111ms) required a connectivity check and retry.
Push rejected after gh pr create because github-actions[bot] pushed a release commit before the next local push — required git fetch + rebase to unblock.
Depth rename in lib.rs had two missed occurrences (error message at line 1089 and doc comment at line 1024) not caught until cargo check ran, requiring a second edit pass.
Python yaml module and pnpm's js-yaml were both unavailable for YAML validation; had to fall back to `ruby -ryaml`.
Write tool failed on pr-body.md because the file hadn't been read first — had to write to pr-body-43.md instead.
Cannot compile or locally verify winfsp-gated Rust code on macOS — all Windows edits are CI-verified only, adding uncertainty to the review loop.
GSD verification gate blocked /gsd:ship even though UAT was complete; required explicitly updating VERIFICATION.md before the workflow could proceed.
The Entire CLI pre-push checkpoint hook runs on every push, adding 30–90 seconds of latency to each push and making the commit-push loop feel slow.
open_items: Consolidate fuser↔winfsp upload + mkdir journal-entry construction into shared CipherBoxFS methods (~150 lines of near-identical code already drifting; security-sensitive D-04/D-05 ordering must be preserved; winfsp CI gate is the only verification).

Replace empty-string sentinel for missing journal IPNS keys with Option<String> uniformly and add a wrap_ipns_key_for_journal helper — parent_ipns_key_hex uses sentinel while file_ipns_key_hex already uses Option, inconsistent within one struct.
Extract shared journal-dir path + DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES constant (currently triplicated across fuse/mod.rs, fuse/windows/mod.rs, commands/sync.rs); clean fix needs a `dirs` dependency in crates/sdk.

Have replay_upload_entry delegate to operations::publish_file_metadata and extract a shared cas_publish_parent helper — replay currently re-inlines ~70+40 lines duplicated across write_ops.rs and platform/windows/write_ops.rs.
Memoize resolve_folder_key during replay_for_vault — currently re-walks vault tree from root for every replayed entry; mount-time replay is super-linear when multiple entries share a parent folder.

Replace 'not found' string-match in replay first-publish detection with a typed Result<Option<u64>> or NotFound variant — a reworded coordinator error silently flips the branch; touches PublishCoordinator and 9 call sites.

Improve phase-43 Rust test coverage: quick wins in crates/sdk/src/sync.rs (4 pure log-redaction functions, 0% coverage); deeper coverage of lib.rs replay requires trait seams enabled by the write-path consolidation refactor.
Repo-wide CI action SHA pinning (all 111 references use version tags) — deferred as a separate CI-hardening initiative, not scoped to phase 43.
The winfsp write-path edits (CR-03/CR-04/simplify cleanups) have only been CI-compile-verified, not locally tested — first real winfsp compile is the PR's CI run.
